# Varshil Gandhi

> Varshil Gandhi is a Sr Applied Scientist leading AI at AirMDR in Bengaluru, building self-improving agents for security operations. Previously a Data & Applied Scientist at Microsoft (2020–2024) working on deep-learning ads relevance. B.Tech in Electronics & Electrical Engineering from IIT Guwahati (2020). Builds things with 3D printers and photographs the night sky.

## Pages

- [Home](https://varshilgandhi.com/): about, experience, projects and hobbies
- [CADForge](https://varshilgandhi.com/writing/cadforge/): an RL environment where AI agents write CadQuery code that becomes manufacture-ready STEP files
- [Kaggle wins](https://varshilgandhi.com/writing/kaggle-medals/): a gold in American Express Default Prediction and a silver in Feedback Prize, and how each solution worked
- [Exoskeleton](https://varshilgandhi.com/projects/exoskeleton/): a wearable rig for collecting egocentric data for robots
- [Placement experience: Microsoft Data Science](https://varshilgandhi.com/blog/placement-experience-microsoft-data-science/)
- [Astrophotography](https://varshilgandhi.com/hobbies/astro/): an observing log plotted on a real sky chart
- [Gardening](https://varshilgandhi.com/hobbies/garden/): a potted garden rebuilt in 3D from two years of photos
